dataset_name: door - Hodapp GmbH und Co. KG - safety door
Use advice for data set: This data set contains the results for modules A1-A3 as well as modules A4, A5, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7, C1, C2, C3, C4, D according to EN 15804. A comparison with other products is only permitted with a comparable application in the building. In principle, a comparison or the evaluation of EPD data is only possible if all data sets to be compared were created according to EN 15804 and the building context, or the product-specific performance characteristics are taken into account. | |
Technical purpose of product or process: Safety door with optional performance features. | |
General comment on data set: A1-A3 as well as modules A4, A5, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7, C1, C2, C3, C4, D. The environmental profile includes the expenses for the life cycle stages cradle to grave. The production of packaging was considered within modules A1-A3. | |
Technology description including backgro: The LCA results cover the life cycle stages of the manufacture of intermediate products up to raw material extraction and processing operations of secondary materials serving as input (e.g. recycling processes), their transports to the plant as well as the production itself, including the provision of all auxiliary and operating materials, energy, and the complete waste treatment or landfilling of residual waste during the stage of production. Modules A1, A2, and A3 are shown here as one aggregated module A1-A3. If further modules were calculated for this data set, they can be found separately and can be combined for a consideration of the entire life cycle.
